title: Correctness: empty algo string not rejected in ioctl_init
description: ioctl_init null-terminates op.algo at line 576 but does not check op.algo[0] \!= '\0'. A zero-initialized crypto2dev_init_op passes this check. crypto2dev_lookup_algo() is called with an empty string, likely returns -ENOENT. This is not a crash but the contract does not explicitly forbid empty algo strings at the UAPI layer, creating an ambiguous failure mode. Fix: check op.algo[0] \!= '\0' and return -EINVAL early.
